en.main:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. Heat dissipates each second by the displayed Cooling Efficiency value. This works even while stowed.

Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and preventing you from using the weapon until Heat drops to 150 or lower.

Starting a Manual Vent at 875 Heat or higher doubles the Vent Rate.

<primary/>Primary Ammo Balanced Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 20% increased direct damage to <link Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles [#CombatantClassifications] />.

en.main:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. Heat dissipates each second by the displayed Cooling Efficiency value, even while stowed. Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and making the weapon unusable until Heat drops to 150 or below.

Manually cancelling a Vent at 125 Heat or below grants 'Dynamic Heat Limiter', decreasing Heat Generation by 50% for 5 seconds. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Gaining the buff by cancelling the Vent through reloading or starting a sprint freezes its timer until the next time you fire the weapon, provided you dealt damage with the weapon before starting that Vent.

Primary Ammo Dynamic Heat Weapons deal increased direct damage based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 15%
• Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles: 38%
• Players: 2.5%

en.main:
Fires slow, tracking projectiles that travel at 40 meters per second with no distance limit (their tracers eventually disappear, however). //Aim Assist Falloff Distance is increased by 50% compared to regular Auto Rifles at 0 Range, scaling down to a 25% increase at 100 Range.

Dealing damage from any source generates 1% Weapon Energy per <pve 4 /> <pvp [3.6] /> damage. Damage dealt with this weapon doubles the amount generated.

Looking near an ally within healing range widens the reticle. Hip-firing in this state fires healing projectiles with much stronger tracking. Each healing shot consumes 2% Weapon Energy and restores 13.3 HP on impact. Shots alternate between allies when multiple are targeted.

Healing range scales linearly from 28 to 38 meters between 0 and 100 Range.

Scoring 5 healing hits on allies within 1 second of each enables subsequent healing hits within 1s of each to grant you and the healed ally 'Support Frame Boost', increasing Weapon Damage by 10% for 6s. Damage increase stacks with everything.

1.5 second cooldown between Support Frame Boost applications on the same ally.

Support Frame Boost applications also grant the ally an effect based on the weapon's element:
• <arc/>Arc: <arc/>Amplified for 7s
• <solar/>Solar: <solar/>Restoration x1 for 4s (6 with <solar/>Ember of Solace)
• <void/>Void: 15 <void/>Void Overshield for 10s (15 with <void/>Echo of Persistence)
• <strand/>Strand: Releases 4 <strand/>Unravel seekers
• <stasis/>Stasis: 1 stack of <stasis/>Frost Armor for 5s

Only applying Rapid Healing triggers On-Heal effects for healed allies. Shots that restore missing health count as Weapon Hits for other perks.

en.body: Shares the 12 second global <strand/>Tangle creation cooldown.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.
Elemental Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
Loads bullets into your magazine but does not need a reload animation and doesn't trigger on-reload perks.
How much your Accuracy Cone expands with each shot fired by your weapon. The less the better.

<barrier/>Shield-Piercing weapons are required to break a <barrier/>Barrier Champion's immunity shield in order to stun them. Damaging their shields also halts their health regeneration for 1.6 seconds.

Additionally, Shield-Piercing weapons can overpenetrate an unlimited number of enemies. They also bypass Hydra Shields, Hobgoblin immunity, (Taken) Phalanx shields, and Scorn Buckler shields.

Titan Barricades receive 30% Increased Damage from Shield-Piercing weapons.

<overload/>Overload Shots/effects apply <overload/>Disruption for <pve 6.5 /> <pvp [5] /> seconds. Applying Disruption stuns <overload/>Overload Champions and prevents them from regenerating health for the duration of the effect.

Disruption decreases damage dealt by PvE Combatants by 25%. It also decreases Melee, Grenade, and Class Ability regeneration speeds by 40% in PvP.
<unstoppable/>Unstoppable Shots/effects are required to stun <unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions – immobilizing them and removing their passive 70% Damage Resistance for the duration of the stun.
